subject: Activation playbook + evaluation plan — handoff to CS & kickoff
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ellen Reyes <ellen.reyes@nimblehealth.com>, Jonas Adler <jonas.adler@nimblehealth.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation playbook + evaluation plan — handoff to CS & kickoff

Hi Marissa + Grace,

Thanks again to the NimbleHealth team for signing — excited to get started. Per our contract (RDW-2028-1174) I’ve attached the first-pass activation playbook and the proposed evaluation plan. This thread is the formal handoff from Sales -> Customer Success; my ask is that CS own scheduling and execution of the MAP from here on.

High-level summary:
- Go-live target: 2028-11-15 (pilot in Production scope: search & triage workflows)
- Evaluation window: 3 weeks of live traffic + smoke tests
- Key success metric: median inference latency < 250ms 95th percentile; recall on clinical search > 82% on benchmark set

Primary roles (proposed):
- Redwood CS lead: Marissa Cole (owner for onboarding and weekly ops)
- Customer PM: Ellen Reyes (day-to-day project owner)
- Engineering liaison (Nimble): Jonas Adler
- Sales point-of-contact (post-handoff escalation): Rafael Mendes

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Confirm CS owner and weekly meeting cadence by 10/05
2) Run risk checklist in tab 'Pre-Start' of Activation_Playbook_v1.xlsx and flag any blockers
3) Propose first kickoff meeting times (30–45 min) in the week of 10/09 — include timezones for Nimble (PT) and Redwood (PT)

Notes on attachments: Activation_Playbook_v1.xlsx contains the mutual action plan table (milestones, owners, target dates). Nimble_eval_plan_v1.pdf contains the evaluation dataset definition and metric definitions.

Marissa / Grace — I left a few suggested target dates in the playbook but happy to align to CS availability.

Thanks,
Rafael
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0143

Attachment: Activation_Playbook_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 KB)
Attachment: Nimble_eval_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ellen Reyes <ellen.reyes@nimblehealth.com>, Jonas Adler <jonas.adler@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation playbook + evaluation plan — handoff to CS & kickoff

Thanks Rafael — looping in Grace as CS Ops lead.

Grace, I’ll take primary ownership and will run the 'Pre-Start' checklist by EOD 10/04. Proposed cadence: weekly 30-min checkpoints (Wed 10:00 PT) until pilot start, then twice-weekly during the 3-week evaluation window.

Quick notes from a first pass in the playbook:
- I see an integration milestone that references an API key rotation window — need confirmation on whether Nimble needs a dedicated VPC endpoint or will operate over our hosted API. That affects the infra milestone by ~7 business days.
- I propose we move the 'evaluation dataset freeze' to 10/20 to allow Nimble time to export the annotated set.

Can Ellen and Jonas confirm availability for kickoff: 10/10 morning (9–11 PT) or 10/11 afternoon (1–4 PT)? If neither works we’ll propose other slots.

Assigning action items:
- Marissa: own kickoff scheduling and MAP updates
- Grace: run Pre-Start checklist and confirm infra needs
- Rafael: hold escalation channel and provide contract milestone visibility

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

Attachment: (none)

From: Ellen Reyes <ellen.reyes@nimblehealth.com>

Cc: Jonas Adler <jonas.adler@nimblehealth.com>, procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation playbook + evaluation plan — handoff to CS & kickoff

Hi all — thanks Rafael and Marissa. Confirmed: NimbleHealth is aligned with the 11/15 target (internal procurement signed this morning). We can commit resources for the pilot but need clarity on the VPC vs hosted API question.

Kickoff availability: 10/11 at 1:30 PM PT works for Ellen and Jonas. If CS needs calendar invites, please send.

Two quick asks for CS before kickoff:
- Can Redwood share the typical ACL/hostname allowlist template?
- Do you have a sample SOC 2 data handling doc we can review with Security (we have a SOC 2 audit next month)?

Thanks,
Ellen
VP Product Operations | NimbleHealth
ellen.reyes@nimblehealth.com | +1 617-555-0199
